invariants.name: density_reaches_layout
invariants.note: A control-metrics change is Layout work. A zero here would mean the metrics change never reached layout, not that it was cheap.

invariants.name: density_does_not_reshape
invariants.note: Control metrics are not typography: changing them must not reshape text.
